spans.s:
For the vowels ए ऐ ओ and औ are respectively substituted अय् आय् अव् and आव् when a vowel follows.

Terms: संहितायाम्
In the diphthongs which are not प्रगृह्य -- ईदूदेद्द्विवचनं प्रगृह्यम्
etc. and which become प्लुत under the circumstances mentioned in प्रत्यभिवादेशूद्रे
etc., but not when that circumstance is a call from a distance -- दूराद्धूते च

; for the first half, there is substituted the prolated आ and for the second portion इ or उ।

Terms: प्लुत
